items.title: Dave Frishberg interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clearwater Beach, Florida, March 16, 2001
items.q: It was — the drummer was Osie Johnson and the bass player was Wendell Marshall. I played piano. A guy by the name of Everett Barksdale played guitar. Clark Terry. Big Nick Nicholas was the tenor player, Jerome Richardson, and somebody else.

ctx.x: Because I remember who the band was. It was astonishing. It was — the drummer was Osie Johnson and the bass player was Wendell Marshall. I played piano. A guy by the name of Everett Barksdale played guitar. Clark Terry. Big Nick Nicholas was the tenor player, Jerome Richardson, and somebody else. Okay. I mean it was, wow, what am I doing in the studio with these people? And this was my very first record date. My knees were like knocking. I couldn’t believe it, that Mat had called me for this. Wow, this is heavy…
Yeah. And all those heavy duty guys in there making —
